name: Department 03: 24/7 AI Customer Support Triage, Grounded RAG & Amber/Red Escalation Gate
project: The Small Business AI Automation Operating System (2026 Enterprise Edition)
sla_benchmark: >= 60% Tier-1 auto-resolution in < 45 seconds; < 15m human takeover on Red Gate

trav_governance_architecture.stage_1_trigger: Webhook / Scheduled Cron Trigger with deterministic event_id idempotency check
trav_governance_architecture.stage_2_rules: Pre-AI Regex Red-Gate Filter + E.164/Email Validator + Locked Truth-Table Lookup

stage_3_ai.system_prompt: You are the Tier-1 Grounded Support Concierge for {{COMPANY_NAME}}. Using ONLY the verified policy clauses in {{KB_TRUTH_TABLE_JSON}} and live order/appointment telemetry in {{LIVE_STATUS_API_JSON}}, classify sentiment (1-5), evaluate kb_confidence (0.0-1.0), assign triage_gate (GREEN | AMBER | RED), and draft a helpful response at temperature 0.0. If the answer is not explicitly in the KB, set triage_gate to AMBER.

stage_4_verification.green: Sentiment >= 3 AND KB Match Confidence >= 0.88 AND $0 concession -> Auto-send grounded reply
stage_4_verification.amber: Sentiment == 3 AND courtesy credit <= $100 -> Post 1-click Amber Approval Card in #amber-support
stage_4_verification.red: Sentiment <= 2 OR Red-Zone Regex Match OR dispute > $100 -> Mute bot & page manager in #red-alerts

sample_payload.inbound_subject: Question about rescheduling my Tuesday morning appointment
sample_payload.inbound_body: Hi team, something came up at work on Tuesday morning. Can I move my 9:00 AM appointment to Thursday afternoon without a fee?

configuration.on_red_zone_match: Route immediately to Node 06 (Red-Gate Human Alert & Bot Mute)

configuration.strict_math_rule: Calculate all prices, discounts, taxes, and overdue day counts in deterministic code prior to Node 04.

configuration.system_prompt: You are the Tier-1 Grounded Support Concierge for {{COMPANY_NAME}}. If the answer is not explicitly in the KB, set triage_gate to AMBER.

actions: Send SMS via Twilio / OpenPhone (if sms_opt_in_verified == true)
Post interactive Block Kit Approval Card to #amber-approvals in Slack ([Approve & Send] | [Edit] | [Hold])
Log pending state in Notion Database 02
Set bot_muted = true on customer record
Post urgent 5-bullet context brief + Emergency Script draft to #red-alerts
Send SMS alert to on-duty human manager

configuration.emergency_script_reference: Activate matching Emergency Script (01–12) if API outage exceeds 15 minutes.

fields.text:
*Target SLA:*
>= 60% Tier-1 auto-resolution in < 45 seconds; < 15m human takeover on Red Gate

make_com_instructions.step_1: Create a new Scenario in Make.com -> Click More (...) in the bottom toolbar -> Select 'Import Blueprint' or add the 6 modules listed in the nodes[] array.
make_com_instructions.step_2: In Module 01 (Custom WebHook), copy the generated HTTPS URL and paste it into your form provider, phone system, or billing webhook settings.
make_com_instructions.step_3: In Module 04 (OpenAI Create a Chat Completion), set Model = gpt-4o-mini, Temperature = 0.0, Response Format = JSON Object, and paste trav_governance_architecture.stage_3_ai.system_prompt.
make_com_instructions.step_4: In Module 05 (Router), configure the 3 filter conditions matching Branch_A_Green, Branch_B_Amber, and Branch_C_Red.

n8n_instructions.step_1: In n8n (Self-Hosted or Cloud), click Workflows -> Add Workflow -> Import from File or configure the 6 n8n_node types in sequence.
n8n_instructions.step_2: Use a Code (JavaScript/Python) node at Step 02 to execute mask_credit_cards_regex, mask_ssn_regex, and red_zone_abort_regex before calling OpenAI.
n8n_instructions.step_3: Connect an Error Trigger node at Step 06 pointing to your Notion Database 02 Dead-Letter Queue table.

zapier_instructions.step_1: Create a 6-step Zap starting with 'Webhooks by Zapier (Catch Hook)' followed by 'Code by Zapier (Run Python)' for PII masking and Red-Gate regex verification.
zapier_instructions.step_2: Use 'Paths by Zapier' at Step 05 to split execution into Green (Auto-Send), Amber (Slack Block Kit Approval), and Red (Pager/Manager Alert).

green_zone_test_case.description: Routine in-policy payload with high KB confidence and zero Red-Zone keywords.

amber_zone_test_case.description: High-value or edge-case payload requiring a 15-second human manager click in Slack #amber-approvals.

red_zone_test_case.description: Payload containing a Red-Zone trigger keyword or severe dispute that immediately halts AI execution and alerts a human lead.
